newsitem.title: USA: Castle Energy closes Texas property sale.
newsitem.headline: Castle Energy closes Texas property sale.

text.p: Castle Energy Corp on Friday said it completed the sale of its Rusk County, Texas, oil and gas properties and pipeline to Union Pacific Resources Group Inc for $54 million.
Castle said it would apply about $13 million of the proceeds to liquidate the company's outstanding debt.

The company's board of directors is currently considering alternatives for using the remaining proceeds from the sale and the proceeds expected to be generated from the company's gas sales contract with Lone Star Gas Co, Castle said.
